international.title: California bans Waymo self-driving cars from freeways
international.summary: State DMV says vehicles pose ‘imminent hazard’ after cars entered closed zone and tried to bypass highway patrol California has banned Waymo’s autonomous vehicles from state freeways, saying they pose an “imminent hazard” after a spate of recent incidents. The restrictions, issued last Wednesday, bar Waymo from “operating or testing its driverless vehicles on all California freeways,” Jonathan Groveman, a spokesperson for the state’s department of motor vehicles, said in a statement.
